description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPurgeTime' implements 'ValueFormatter' and provides a method to get the current date and time, utilizing a trait 'DateTimeHelperTrait'. It appears to be part of a larger system related to data formatting and purge strategies for maintenance tasks within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeTime
classes.description: Provides a formatted current date/time for purge operations.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the current date and time using the helper trait.
